Its design is intended to decrease blind spots without sacrificing too much defense.|Inventory|TotK}} The Shield of the Mind's Eye goes unnamed in {{AoC}}. ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Shield |strength = 16 |durability = 16 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Shield of the Mind's Eye}} Shields of the Mind's Eye are small [[Sheikah]]-made [[Shield]]s found in both [[East Necluda]] and [[West Necluda]]. They also have a chance to appear in [[Treasure Chest]]s that spawn when the {{SSB}} Series [[Sheik]] [[amiibo]] is scanned with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]]. Shields of the Mind's Eye were designed to decrease the wielder's blind spots without sacrificing too much in the way of defense. These Shields belong to the [[Sheikah Gear]] equipment archetype, a series of [[Weapon]]s created by the modern Sheikah.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 170}} Being made of metal, Shields of the Mind's Eye will conduct [[Electricity]] and attract [[Lightning]] if they are equipped during a [[Thunderstorm]]. They will also sink if are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], but they can be picked up and manipulated with the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. Finally, they will not burn when exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]] like a wooden Shield does. {{BotW Shield Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Shield_041" |Life = 16 |GuardPower = 16 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 2 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 4 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMin = 7 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMax = 12 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 5 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 8 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMin = 13 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMax = 24 |RideBreakRatio = 1.0 |MirrorLevel = 0 |SurfingFriction = 0.25 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = Shield |strength = 16 |durability = 16 |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Shield of the Mind's Eye}} {{Stub|TotK}} Shields of the Mind's Eye reappear in {{TotK}}. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} The Shield of the Mind's Eye can be wielded by [[Link]] in conjunction with the [[Prototype Ancient Short Sword]]s. It is exclusively available as part of the purchase bonus for the game's [[Hyrule Warriors: Age of Calamity Expansion Pass|Expansion Pass]]. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:BotW Shield of the Mind's Eye Concept Artwork.png|Concept art of a Shield of the Mind's Eye from {{BotW|-}} File:AoC Prototype Ancient Gear.jpg|Link with the Shield of the Mind's Eye from {{AoC|-}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Sheikah Gear * Shield }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Sheikah Gear, Shields |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
